title: 2023 Big Ideas in Technology (Part 1)

reader_summary.overview: At the end of 2022. Emerging from this exercise came literally 40-plus builder-worthy pursuits for the year. And that ranged from entertainment franchise games to precision delivery of medicines, small modular reactors, and of course, loads of AI applications.

key_points.evidence_quote: At the end of 2022, our team at ACTVV has dozens of partners across the firm to spotlight one big idea that startups in their fields could tackle in 2023.

thesis: The podcast argues that social commerce is an inevitable trend where platforms must reduce friction between product discovery and purchase completion. It further posits that live video shopping, which leverages community interaction and time-limited discounts to build consumer confidence, is significantly underdeveloped in Western markets compared to Asia.
